title: manage_storage
description: File and manage the owner's documents. Ops: file/put/read/get/describe/find/move/copy/delete. Keys under pages/ serve on the owner web portal; put returns the link. You compose paths + captions.

op.description: file: caption an existing object at key. put: write text/markdown/json you composed (content). read: the content, windowed. get: a presigned link for the human. describe | find | move | copy | delete.

content.description: put: the document body; content type from the key's extension.

key.description: Object key, a human-meaningful path (receipts/office-supply/staples.png), never a uuid. get/describe/delete/read, and the target of file. Keys under pages/ publish to the owner portal: body-only html; the shell adds live data (await ui.data('tasks')) and auto-refresh; a <form method=post action="f/<kind>"> lands in submissions/<kind>/. One page per turn (continue_later between).

prefix.description: find: path prefix to search under, e.g. receipts/.

query.description: find: text matched against the caption.

after.description: find: occurred_at on/after this ISO date.

before.description: find: occurred_at on/before this ISO date.

title.description: Caption title, set at file time.

note.description: Caption note, set at file time.

tags.description: Caption tags, set at file time.

occurred_at.description: The date the document is from (the purchase date), ISO; set at file time.

retention.description: retained = legal/PII, never auto-deleted; default ordinary.

offset.description: read: byte to start from (default 0); pass the reply's next_offset for the next window.

max_bytes.description: read: bytes per window (default 16384); the reply carries size and truncated.
